gloss: to cool oneself, to enjoy the cool

definitions.gloss: to cool oneself, to enjoy the cool
definitions.explanation: To seek relief from heat by going to a cool place or catching a breeze.

examples.english: Enjoy the cool air on the veranda.

examples.japanese: {暑|あつ}いから{木陰|こかげ}で{涼|すず}んでいた。
examples.english: It was hot, so I was cooling off in the shade of a tree.

examples.japanese: {夕涼|ゆうすず}みに{散歩|さんぽ}に{出|で}かけた。
examples.english: I went out for a walk to enjoy the evening cool.

notes:
{涼|すず}む means to cool oneself or enjoy cool air, especially during hot summer days.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: Intransitive ({自動詞|じどうし})
- Pattern: Xで{涼|すず}む (cool off at X)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {縁側|えんがわ}で{涼|すず}む (to cool off on the veranda)
- {木陰|こかげ}で{涼|すず}む (to cool off in the tree shade)
- {夕涼|ゆうすず}み (enjoying the evening cool) [noun]

CULTURAL NOTE:
Enjoying the cool breeze ({涼|すず}む) is a traditional Japanese way of coping with hot summers. Activities include sitting on the {縁側|えんがわ} (veranda), listening to {風鈴|ふうりん} (wind chimes), or going out for {夕涼|ゆうすず}み in the evening.

RELATED:
- {涼|すず}しい (cool, refreshing) [i-adjective]
